  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3593301703",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "In pruned mode, requesting a pruned block returns 'I/O error reading block data' instead of 'Block not available'",
      "quote": "In pruned mode when user calls `getrawtransaction <txid> <blockhash>` for the block that is pruned we return `\"I/O error reading block data\"` instead we should return `\"Block not available\"` which was",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "yuvicc confirmed the earlier concern has been addressed",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4084800456"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5535784114",
      "status_by_quote": "My earlier concern has been addressed."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3595197636",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Wrap functional test assertions in a try...finally block so the renamed block file is always restored",
      "quote": "would it be safer to wrap the assertions in a `try...finally` block so that the block file is always restored, even if an assertion or unexpected exception causes the test to exit early.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "maflcko explained teardown deletes the temporary test directory anyway so restoring the file is unnecessary",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3595248537",
        "rc:4084843804"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4084843804",
      "status_by_quote": "I don’t think a finally block is needed here: if an assertion fails, the functional test’s temporary datadir is deleted "
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6171297356",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Add a short release note explaining that some RPCs now report index or read errors instead of continuing with fallback lookups or reporting a missing transaction",
      "quote": "Would a short release note make sense for this, since some rpcs now report index or read errors where they previously continued with other lookups or reported a missing tx?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "maflcko added the release note and enirox001 confirmed",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6191880357"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5535384425",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks for applying the changes. LGTM"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5511366844",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Whether throwing immediately in FindTx prevents callers from trying fallback lookups (such as UTXO set lookup in ProcessPSBT) that might succeed",
      "quote": "I wonder if throwing immediately here could prevent callers from trying other lookups that might still succeed for example in `ProcessPSBT`",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "maflcko clarified it is intentional to notify about index corruption early, and enirox001 agreed",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6169950150"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6171297356",
      "status_by_quote": "Sounds good, letting the user know early on that the index is corrupted is a good idea"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5546709537",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Add CDBIterator::CheckStatus and call it in FindTx so LevelDB iterator errors throw instead of returning nullopt",
      "quote": "Could we add this to the public methods of `CDBIterator` in `dbwrapper.h`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "maflcko noted this is a pre-existing issue that makes sense as a follow-up PR, and musaHaruna agreed to open one",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6214014188"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6214146635",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes I think a separate PR makes sense. I will open one as a follow-up to this."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:4988714009",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Distinguishing “transaction not found” from internal read failures in TxIndex::FindTx/GetTransaction makes sense.",
      "substantive": true,
